tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations vary only u_now; dependence on the other inputs and the bridge mechanism are not identifiable. The bridge-specific probe can distinguish the competing explanations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies only u_now, so its apparent saturation cannot distinguish this from a mobility bridge.
The pilot response is markedly nonlinear in u_now and does not establish the bridge dependence.
The cheaper branch-discriminating probe directly addresses the mechanism ambiguity.
